name: Lalvin EC-1118
notes: Neutral, very robust; strips delicate aromatics. Good restart yeast.

name: Lalvin K1-V1116
notes: Fruity esters at cool temps; tolerant of high gravity. Killer factor.

name: Lalvin 71B
notes: Metabolises part of the malic acid — softens tart fruit. Drink young.

name: Lalvin ICV-D47
notes: Rich mouthfeel; fusels above 20 °C — keep cool.

name: Lalvin QA23
notes: Clean, citrus/tropical thiols; good for light traditionals.

name: Lalvin RC212
notes: Red-fruit and spice; good for dark berry melomels.

name: Lalvin BM 4X4
notes: Big body and fruit; demands nitrogen.

name: Mangrove Jack's M05
notes: Purpose-built mead strain; dry and clean.

name: White Labs WLP720 Sweet Mead
notes: Liquid; leaves sweetness, slower to finish.

name: Kveik (Voss)
notes: Ferments hot and fast without fusels; orange-peel esters.

name: Lalvin BM45
notes: Jammy fruit, rose and spice with a round, full body; slow and needs nitrogen. Great for dark berry and cherry melomels.

name: Lalvin ICV-D80
notes: Big structure and dark fruit; pairs with oak and tannic fruit. Keep nitrogen up.

name: Lalvin Rhône 4600
notes: Fresh, fruity and floral at cool temperatures; good for delicate traditionals.

name: Red Star Premier Blanc
notes: Neutral and vigorous (formerly Pasteur Champagne); restarts stuck ferments.

name: Red Star Premier Classique
notes: All-round wine yeast (formerly Montrachet); full-bodied, can make sulphur if short of nitrogen.

name: Red Star Premier Rouge
notes: Red-fruit and body (formerly Pasteur Red); suits berry and grape melomels.

name: Red Star Premier Côte des Blancs
notes: Slow, gentle and fruity; often leaves a little sweetness. Popular for traditional meads.

name: Omega Lutra Kveik
notes: Very clean kveik; ferments warm and fast with little ester.
